items.text: If you take a weight loss peptide, lift weights and maintain proper protein intake so you do not lose a lot of muscle mass.
Do not take a GLP-1 peptide if you are already at a healthy body fat percentage, feel good, and are performing well.
Make diet and exercise your first go-to for weight loss.
If you have been struggling to lose weight, talk to your doctor about a GLP-1 medication so you can come to a decision together.
Manage your training loads, try to find pain-free variations, and gradually build yourself back up over time to heal an injury.
If your injury is not getting better, have it looked at by a qualified physical therapist.
Do not take BPC 157 because the human evidence is lacking and sourcing can be sketchy; stick to verified, safe methods instead.
To help slow down aging, exercise, sleep well, do not smoke, do not drink too much, and try to maintain a healthy body weight.
Do not take an anti-aging peptide because the human evidence is really scant.
